findings.title: Non-existent no-argument isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() call breaks compilation
findings.body: The new condition calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments. The only inherited method is isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) from UsernamePasswordForm, so this source file will not compile. If the intent was to check the current user, it should likely be isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()).

findings.title: Passkey conditional UI is no longer populated for unidentified users
findings.body: authenticate() now calls webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context) only when isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()) is true. That helper returns false when user is null: return webauthnAuth != null && webauthnAuth.isPasskeysEnabled() && user != null. In the normal first-factor username/password flow, context.getUser() is null at this point, so the WebAuthn conditional UI attributes are never set, and the initial login page will no longer include the passkey form/autofill. Previously the else branch filled the form for unknown users when passkeys were enabled. This breaks normal discoverable-passkey login from the initial username/password page and contradicts the still-present tests that expect //form[@id='webauth'] after openLoginForm.
